recommended_text.sec4_par_l41: TRICERATOPS 1.1.0 \citep{Giacalone2021}, with Sector 32+98 folds (5--10\,min bins) and companions unresolved within $2.2''$, gives FPP $=0.03$--0.04 for the 3.18\,d signal ($0.031\pm0.003$ for the adopted 6-min fold) and 0.13--0.21 for the 11.13\,d signal. It tests only astrophysical scenarios; for the 3.18\,d signal, an ephemeris coherent across sectors and pipelines argues against an instrumental origin. About 90\% of its FPP comes from companions above $0.38\,M_\odot$; adding the Gaia RUWE and contrast limits of MOLUSC \citep{Wood2021} to the default companion prior gives 0.002--0.004 and 0.06--0.08. \citet{Giacalone2021} calibrated FPP $<0.015$ with NFPP $<10^{-3}$ for circular orbits, so I claim no validation. No multiplicity boost is applied because the 11.13\,d signal is not secure.
recommended_text.abstract: TRICERATOPS gives FPP $=0.03$--0.04 under its default assumptions.
